# netactuate_bgp_sessions (Resource)

Manages a BGP Sessions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_bgp_sessions" "example" {
  group_id = 12345
  mbpkgid  = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) BGP group ID assigned by the API.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Package ID assigned by the API.

### Optional

- `ipv6` (Boolean) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `redundant` (Boolean) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_bgp_sessions.example 12345
```
